description: Finds the one missing number among four that sit in the same equation, a single amount earning one fixed yearly rate with interest added at a chosen frequency (FV = PV x (1 + r/n)^(n x t)): the future value, the starting amount, the annual rate, or the time in years. Use when the user knows three of the four and wants the fourth, e.g. "what rate turns $10,000 into $20,000 in 10 years", "how many years until $10,000 reaches $20,000 at 6%", or "what do I need to start with to reach $50,000". Do not use for regular contributions (use smartfin_project_savings_growth), for what a real investment did (use smartfin_calculate_investment_return), or for a forecast: one fixed rate is an assumption, and a required rate is the arithmetic, not a return to expect. To only grow an amount forward use smartfin_calculate_future_value.

annual_rate_pct.description: Yearly rate in %, above -100, e.g. 6. Leave out when solving for annual_rate_pct

compounding_frequency.description: Times a year interest is added: 1 annually, 2 semiannually, 4 quarterly, 12 monthly, 52 weekly, 365 daily

currency.description: Currency symbol for the amounts in the summary only; amounts are never converted. The link opens the page in US dollars, and how_to says to pick the currency there. Default USD

future_value.description: Amount at the end in the currency chosen. Leave out when solving for future_value

present_value.description: Starting amount in the currency chosen. Leave out when solving for present_value

solve_for.description: Which number to find: future_value, present_value (the starting amount), annual_rate_pct or years

years.description: Time in years; a part of a year is a decimal. Leave out when solving for years

name: smartfin_calculate_missing_variable

how_to.description: Steps for the user to see or redo this on smartfin.fyi

embed.description: Free embed code for this calculator, for a site the user runs

page.description: SmartFin's page for this stock, when it has one

smartfin.description: Open and adjust this result on smartfin.fyi

summary.description: Plain-language result the assistant can quote

title: Solve for the missing number: future value, starting amount, rate or time
